Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid - 3 days in office, 2 days remote)
Company: Horizon Global Logistics

ABOUT THE ROLE:
Horizon Global Logistics is seeking an experienced Senior Supply Chain Specialist to optimize our North American distribution network. In this role, you will analyze multimodal freight carrier contracts, negotiate ocean and air shipping tariffs, and implement automated inventory tracking software across six regional distribution centers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Monitor vendor performance metrics, including on-time delivery rates and customs compliance.
- Forecast quarterly freight capacity requirements and establish contingency transport routes.
- Collaborate with procurement teams to reduce overall logistics expenditures by at least 8% annually.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Industrial Engineering.
- Minimum of five years of professional experience in logistics procurement or freight forwarding.
- Demonstrated proficiency in SAP Enterprise Resource Planning and advanced Excel data modeling.
- APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) credential preferred.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:
We offer a competitive annual salary of $95,000 to $115,000, comprehensive medical and dental insurance, 401(k) matching up to 6%, and an annual professional development budget of $2,500.

TO APPLY: Please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@horizonglobal.com by November 15.

APEX INNOVATIONS — INTERNAL POLICY BULLETIN

Policy #HR-402: Tuition Reimbursement and Professional Certification Program
Effective Date: January 1
Target Audience: All full-time permanent employees with at least twelve months of continuous service

OBJECTIVE: Apex Innovations is committed to fostering lifelong learning and career advancement among our workforce. Under Policy HR-402, eligible employees may receive reimbursement for college courses, degree programs, and accredited professional certifications that directly enhance job performance.

PROGRAM GUIDELINES:
1. Financial Cap: Employees may claim up to $5,250 per calendar year for eligible tuition, textbook purchases, and mandatory laboratory fees.
2. Academic Requirement: To qualify for reimbursement, participants must achieve a grade of 'B' (or 3.0 GPA) or higher in graded coursework, or a verified 'Pass' in non-graded certification exams.
3. Application Timeline: Employees must submit a Course Pre-Approval Form to their department director at least three weeks prior to the start of classes.
4. Retention Commitment: Recipients agree to remain employed with Apex Innovations for at least twelve months following the completion of a reimbursed course. If an employee resigns voluntarily prior to this period, the reimbursed funds must be repaid on a prorated basis.

For application templates and a list of partner academic institutions, visit the intranet benefits portal.

PORTLAND TO POWER MUNICIPAL WATER UTILITIES WITH 20-MEGAWATT SOLAR FACILITY
By Cynthia Howard

PORTLAND, OREGON — The Portland City Council yesterday gave final unanimous approval for the construction of the Columbia Solar Energy Center, a 20-megawatt photovoltaic installation slated for vacant industrial land near the Columbia River. The $28 million public-private partnership between the city and Solaria Clean Power is scheduled to break ground next spring, with commercial energy generation slated for early 2028.

Once completed, the solar farm will generate an estimated 32,000 megawatt-hours of clean electricity annually—sufficient to supply 100 percent of the energy needs for Portland's primary wastewater treatment and water filtration facilities. City environmental officials estimate that the transition to solar will reduce municipal greenhouse gas emissions by approximately 18,000 metric tons per year, equivalent to removing nearly 4,000 passenger vehicles from local highways.

"This landmark clean energy initiative demonstrates our unwavering commitment to reaching carbon neutrality by 2035," said Mayor Gregory Bennett during the press briefing. "Not only does this project safeguard our environment, but it will also protect taxpayers against volatile fossil fuel electricity rates over the next three decades."

- Thirty (30) AMR units capable of transporting payloads up to 1,200 pounds.
- Automated high-density vertical carousel storage units for fast-moving SKU merchandise.
- Optical barcode verification scanners at all conveyor packing stations.

PROJECTED BENEFITS:
1. Throughput Efficiency: Increases daily order dispatch capacity by 65%, reducing average pick-to-ship latency to under 75 minutes.
2. Accuracy: Decreases picking and sorting discrepancies to below 0.1%, virtually eliminating customer return claims due to wrong items.
3. Return on Investment (ROI): The total capital investment of $780,000 is projected to yield full cost amortization within 14 months through labor redeployment and reduced overtime overhead.

IMPLEMENTATION TIMELINE:
Phase 1 (Site Survey & Network Prep): Weeks 1-4
Phase 2 (Hardware Installation & AMR Testing): Weeks 5-10
Phase 3 (Staff Training & Full Go-Live): Weeks 11-12

ANNUAL "5K FOR HOPE" CHARITY RUN SCHEDULED FOR SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 2
By Rachel Green, Corporate Social Responsibility Committee

Get your running shoes ready! Apex Corporation's sixth annual "5K for Hope" charity fun run and wellness walk will take place on Saturday, November 2, at Riverside Memorial Park. All funds raised through participant registration fees and corporate sponsorships will be donated directly to the Children's Health & Nutrition Foundation of Greater Chicago.

EVENT HIGHLIGHTS:
- Course: A scenic, flat 5-kilometer paved loop along the scenic banks of the river, suitable for runners, joggers, and walkers of all fitness abilities.
- Team Competition: Departments are encouraged to form teams of five or more participants. The department with the highest percentage of staff participation will win the coveted "Apex Community Cup" and an all-expenses-paid celebratory catered lunch.
- Entry Package: Every registered participant will receive an official dri-fit event running shirt, a commemorative medal, and a post-race breakfast snack box containing fresh fruit, protein bars, and cold-pressed juices.

REGISTRATION DETAILS:
Registration is $25 for employees and $15 for family members and children under 16. To sign up, please visit the CSR committee page on the intranet portal before Friday, October 25. Volunteers are also needed to manage hydration water stations along the course and hand out medals at the finish line.

ISSUED BY: Pacific Horizon Logistics Authority
PROJECT: Structural Modernization & Solar Retrofit of Warehouse Terminal 4
RFQ Reference: RFQ-2024-LOG-902
Issue Date: August 15 | Submission Deadline: September 20

PROJECT SCOPE:
The Authority invites competitive engineering bids to upgrade our 80,000-square-foot cargo consolidation terminal at Port of Seattle. Core deliverables include:
1. Reinforced concrete floor resurfacing to accommodate high-capacity automated forklifts.
2. Installation of a 500-kilowatt rooftop commercial solar panel array.
3. Replacement of twenty manual roll-up loading bay doors with insulated high-speed automated doors.

EVALUATION CRITERIA: Technical feasibility (35%), proposed total cost (35%), environmental sustainability credentials (15%), and verified completion timeline (15%). Work must be completed within six months of contract signing.

To: Tender Evaluation Committee, Pacific Horizon Logistics Authority
Date: September 18
Bid Reference: VP-BID-902-REV

2. Rooftop Solar Array: 500-kW Tier-1 monocrystalline panels with smart micro-inverters: $420,000
3. Automated Bay Doors: 20 insulated RapidRoll steel doors with motion sensors: $190,000
4. Project Management & Structural Engineering Certification: $110,000

Total Proposed Fixed Price: $1,000,000.00
Execution Timeline: 20 weeks from notice to proceed (well within the six-month RFQ mandate).
Sustainability Credentials: LEED Gold certified construction contractor; 90% of demolition waste recycled.
